text:
incident-bot: PAGER — sev=2. Spike in 5xx + tokenization errors for /v1/generate on model redwood-open-3b in us-west-2. Alerting oncall.

sre-oncall: acked. investigating now. any recent releases?

mike.eng: I pushed a variant this morning: redwood-open-3b@v2.1 to canary (10%). No failures in staging. Rolling through release pipeline earlier today.

julia-ml: seeing a bunch of decoding errors in the logs: "Unknown token id" and garbled control chars in outputs. Tokenizer mismatch looks likely — serving is using tokenizer_spec v2024-04 but the deployed weightset metadata claims v2023-11.

mike.eng: hmm that's bad. release pipeline promoted a weightset alias "latest" which apparently pointed to an older, quantized weight artifact. I'm starting a rollback.

deploy-bot: Command received: /deploy rollback model redwood-open-3b@v2.1 — initiating rollback job rb-1766669999-1.

sre-oncall: quick check — is this impacting paid tenants or only internal tests?

product-sr: Support: three customers reporting failures (acme-inc, home-prod, devshop). Batch jobs failing with 5xx; some retries triggered. CS creating tickets now.

julia-ml: telemetry confirms: requests with long contexts (>2048) exhibit KV cache misalignment and token decode exceptions. This matches a tokenizer/weights mismatch. Recommend immediate flag-based fallback to stable model.

ops: flipping feature flag: model_route.redwood-open-3b -> stable@v2.0 (kill-switch). Will route canary -> stable.

mike.eng: feature flag flipped. canary traffic scaled down. verifying.

incident-bot: Automation update: routing fallback applied, stable@v2.0 now receiving 100% traffic in us-west-2. Rollback job rb-1766669999-1 in progress.

product-sr: I notified affected customers that we're mitigating and will follow up with a postmortem.

sre-oncall: watching metrics — 5xx rate dropped back to baseline within 90s of the flag flip. Tokenization error logs decreased.

julia-ml: pulling manifests now to diff metadata. snippet from the failing logs: ```
ERROR decode: Unknown token id 0xFF at position 1024
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/inference/tokenizer.py", line 412, in decode
    return tokenizer.decode(ids)
  ValueError: Unknown token id 255
```

mike.eng: confirmed root cause: release automation accepted a weight manifest with duplicate alias "latest" that pointed to an older quantized weightset lacking updated "tokenizer_spec" metadata. The weightset hash abc123 references tokenizer v2023-11 while our serving config expects v2024-04. The alias race allowed old artifacts to be promoted.

ops: creating follow-up ticket: INF-2314 — release pipeline validation: block alias promotion unless tokenizer_spec matches expected model manifest. Also add a pre-promotion checksum between weightset and tokenizer metadata.

product-sr: customer impact summary: 3 customers experienced transient failures (approx 2–5 min). Retries handled most jobs; no data corruption reported. We'll include timeline + mitigation in postmortem.

sre-oncall: rolling notes for handoff: rollback complete, stable routing confirmed, error rates normal. Please monitor for residual tokenization anomalies for next 2h.

hana-oncall: ack — will take watch for the next 2h and confirm tomorrow morning. pls attach any follow-up logs to the ticket.

mike.eng: postmortem action: add stronger gating in CI for artifact aliasing, add a canary validation test that runs tokenization roundtrip checks against the promoted tokenizer_spec.

incident-bot: Incident timeline created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1766669999 — sev=2, status=mitigated, next steps: postmortem in 48h.

product-sr: thanks all. I'll draft the customer communication.

sre-oncall: closing pager for now, keeping channel open for follow-up.
